ios.desc:
Kompakt uses on-device AI to find duplicate and similar photos in your library, then helps you clean them up in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Kompakt scans your photo library and computes visual fingerprints entirely on your device.
2. It groups similar photos together using smart clustering algorithms.
3. You swipe through groups to keep your best shots and remove the rest.

KEY FEATURES
- 100% Private: Your photos never leave your device. No cloud, no uploads, no accounts.
- Smart Grouping: AI-powered clustering finds duplicates and near-duplicates automatically.
- Quick Cleanup: Swipe-based interface makes reviewing photos fast and fun.
- Storage Insights: See exactly how much space you have freed and track your cleanup impact.

Kompakt is built for people who take lots of photos and want to keep their library tidy without spending hours manually sorting through thousands of images.
